title: The Girl Who Played with Fire
author: Stieg Larsson
summary: Hacker Lisbeth Salander is accused of three murders after journalists researching sex trafficking are killed. She disappears, while the magazine editor who knows her tries to clear her name.
readIf: you finished the first book and want Lisbeth's story to take centre stage.
skipIf: you have not read the first book, or want to avoid depictions of violence against women.

pairings.reason: The first book in the series, and the place to start for the full story.
Another fast thriller with a lone, resourceful hero pulled into a conspiracy.
A different hero, but the same breakneck rhythm and a clever, ruthless opponent.
